name: qa-engineer-challenge-automation
description: Manual and automated test solution for the QA Engineer challenge using WebdriverIO + TypeScript.

scripts.test:desktop:slow: cross-env TARGET=desktop SLOW_MO_MS=250 PAUSE_AFTER_TEXT_MS=1500 wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts
